summary.name: Notes from Production Engineering
summary.one_liner: A 2015 SREcon15 conference talk by Pedro Canahuati, director of Production Engineering at Facebook, on how Facebook's operations team evolved into a decentralized engineering team.
use_cases: Learning how a large web company organized its production engineering team
Understanding how to bring developers closer to operations
Researching hiring and prioritization in SRE teams
Reading background on scaling operations at high traffic services
summary.what_it_does: This is a conference talk page for a presentation at SREcon15 (USENIX, Santa Clara, March 2015). The talk describes Facebook's operations team evolving from a small, centralized, sometimes marginalized group overwhelmed by production issues into a decentralized engineering team that supports fast product changes. It covers culture, hiring practices, prioritization, and philosophies for getting developers closer to ops and doing operations work themselves. The page cites scale figures such as over 1.39 billion monthly users and hundreds of thousands of servers across multiple data centers.
notable: Firsthand account from Facebook's director of Production Engineering
Covers the shift from centralized ops to developers doing ops
Discusses culture, hiring, and prioritization for SRE teams
caveats: Page is a talk description; the page text does not include the talk's slides, video, or notes content
Registration fee shown on page ($400) applies to the conference, not to this talk
